protocol.candidate_scope: actual owner GPX visits at actual passage times
protocol.strict_rule: Only top-ranked route visits count. Whole-route coverage is not counted as prediction accuracy.
protocol.leakage_guard: Target-night captures are hidden from model training.

selected_variant.selection_note: All tested alpha/beta variants tied on the early selection score, so this is a deterministic tie-break rather than evidence that 1.0/1.0 is uniquely best.

exploratory_only.warning: These confirmation results must not be used to select alpha/beta because that would contaminate the holdout.

interpretation.time_thresholds_identical_reason: For captures recovered by a high-ranked spatial candidate, the realized GPX passage was already within 10 minutes. Therefore 10/20/30/60 minute rates are identical in this replay and the result is dominated by spatial prioritization, not proof of 10-minute forecasting accuracy.
interpretation.current_answer: The owner-personal score shows useful route prioritization signal in the upper 10-20 percent of actually driven visits, but top-1/top-5 precision remains weak and the strict confirmation sample is only 9 captures.
interpretation.next_required_validation: Generate road-by-10-minute candidate slots before the night, compare against random/exposure baselines, and score a precommitted route schedule against future captures.
